articles.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang’s exit
articles.description: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed its open source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face, despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
articles.description: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Sam Altman warns against a future where AI, not humans, calls the shots
articles.description: Altman and Greg Brockman pushed back against Silicon Valley's growing debate over an AI takeover, while acknowledging the challenges of keeping advanced models under human control.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says it’s ‘hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen’
articles.description: Nvidia founder and former CEO Jensen Huang stepped down last week amid several scandals, including an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: Nvidia clarifies when it will — and won’t — keep financing neoclouds
articles.description: If Nvidia is backstopping a data center loan, it won't be on the hook unless the neocould has independent financing and gets the facility built, with Nvidia gear installed, interim CEO Colette Kress explained.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Felicis leads $7.5M bet on Unsiloed AI to make enterprise documents usable by AI agents
articles.description: With a team of just seven, Unsiloed AI plans to compete with tech giants and specialized startups in the crowded AI document-processing market.
articles.author: Jagmeet Singh

articles.title: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed U.S. robotics companies the data they need
articles.description: Founded in February, Humyn Labs competes with startups including Mecka AI and XDOF, with about 90% of its revenue coming from the U.S.
articles.author: Jagmeet Singh

articles.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future  deals in doubt
articles.description: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.
articles.author: Dominic-Madori Davis, Marina Temkin

articles.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
articles.description: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Nvidia is abandoning China after Jensen Huang’s ouster
articles.description: Nvidia's interim CEO says the company is done selling chips to China. How much will that cost?
articles.author: Tim Fernholz
